title: New World chrome, skin and blocks: header, footer, hero variants, Groups, Your first visit, Tools, Events and the function blocks

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-03: New World is the new mega template, default theme for every new Space

detail:
Its own components (components/sites/new-world-*, components/page-editor/blocks/new-world.tsx), not the Services ones. Empty states on every list block; no literal colours. Coordinate with the builder audit thread (#4510, 'Apply the new builder to every theme'), which covers the role blocks.

New World has its own 20 section blocks (components/page-editor/blocks/new-world.tsx) and section sheet (components/sites/new-world-sections-css.ts), drawn from the handoff's site kit: hero, numbers, story, groups, live calendar, first visit, live reviews, team, ways in, plans, live openings, gallery, notes, how it works, where, ask, newsletter, live questions, tools and closer. Every kit Home now composes them; the other kit pages move in LIVE-2056.
